scope: Check each proposed shared-cut edit at the original mask resolution before advancing the batch. Keep the incoming error ceiling and the existing feature, geometry, paper, symmetry and final whole-batch checks. Cropping and colour classification are unchanged.

regular.criteria: Each prepare + solve + validate + export <=10 seconds; independent error <= that case’s validated release error, plus at most 1 percentage point for an identical pair; unchanged geometry, strict paper and substantial feature checks. Decode and independent external replay are timed separately. Optional retained snapshots reproduce the compute-worker observer; thread startup and message transfer are excluded.

editable.method: Saved engine geometry and exact classified mask through production validated conversion, SVG serialization/parsing, editor intersection rules and source-mask replay. No new fitting or crop correction. Not a browser interaction test.

browser.method: Page-clock timestamps from the Find click, worker requests/replies and the first visible, enabled Open in Draw button. DOM readiness is not a paint timestamp. Result capture and artifact writes happen afterward and have separate Node-clock durations. Version 1 solveAndConversionSeconds included harness capture and artifact writes and is not directly comparable.

findings: Jigsaw automatic crop follows a false foreground boundary and skews the pattern. A historical hand-reviewed crop reaches a checked fit faster; those approximate corners are not ground truth.

Bauble automatic bottom corner lies outside the 1112-pixel photograph. The frame is also substantially lost during classification of the historical crop. Switching to the existing red/white-mixture model did not recover it.
At 25 seconds, the automatic jigsaw and bauble targets can both pass fit checks despite visually wrong crops. Low mask error does not establish accurate reconstruction of the photograph.
Outline star and crossed ribbons miss small isolated classified fragments near the crop edge. No source or feature threshold was changed to count them as successes.
Gap filling, lobe-palette segmentation and gradient-derived lower-side proposals did not reliably fix the bad outlines, and were not added to production.

stopReplay.method: HTTP source override: block the actual compute worker for 30 s before fitting (empty), or immediately after a real validated checkpoint with error <= 0.6% (keep), or finer paper resolution 700 and original-image error <= 3% (keep-finer), or the new detail-polishing stage with resolution 700 and original-image error <= 2.6% (keep-detail). Cancel-finishing additionally yields for 2 s in finalization. No geometry, counts or seed is supplied.

browserReplayNote: The first browser run could not import the application entry after an in-place build. The stale preview process was restarted; entry URLs and all 65 engine/worker JavaScript assets were then verified and the full browser suite replayed.
limitations: Independent image scores refer to the classified mask, not unavailable ground-truth cutting paths.
Small-feature preservation is a raster check, not an exact topology proof.

Visual browser review: the hat motif is clean apart from small edge imperfections; the puppy retains a thin body seam and frame defects. Passing the numerical gates does not make these exact reconstructions.
All fitted and edited candidates still require user review; no physical assembly test was performed.

reproduction.tests: npm test; npm run check; npm run lint; npm run build (run sequentially)
reproduction.browser: Use scripts/inverse/paint-browser-test.mjs with PLAYWRIGHT_MODULE pointing to a private installed Playwright, INVERSE_TEST_URL to a freshly started production preview, INVERSE_TEST_BROWSERS=chromium,webkit and INVERSE_TEST_CASES=hard-flettede-puppy,hard-flettede-puppy-half,puppy-shift-mask,bird-mask,gift-mask,top-hat-independent,star. Save outputs to a fresh directory using INVERSE_TEST_OUTPUT.
reproduction.stop: Run the same browser harness afterward with INVERSE_TEST_CASES=puppy-shift-mask and INVERSE_TEST_STOP=keep-detail.
reproduction.cropDiagnostics: At baseline af43639, run hard-photo-benchmark.mjs separately with --ids=jigsaw,bauble --target=mask --seconds=25 for --crop=fixed and --crop=automatic. Run --ids=outline-star,crossed-ribbons --crop=automatic --target=mask --seconds=25 for border-feature diagnostics.
reproduction.note: Use fresh output directories. Heavy jobs were run serially; automatic photo cropping and decode are outside the regular speed benchmark timer. No reference cutting paths initialize any fit.
